~~~

~~~

## PARQUET_FIELD_REQUESTED_MORE_THAN_ONCE

SQLSTATE `KD000`.

~~~text
Requested fields <requestedFields> resolve to the same Parquet field <parquetField>, which can be read only once. When <fieldIdReadConf> is enabled, a requested field with a field ID is resolved by ID and any other requested field by name. Request the Parquet field only once, and refer to the resulting column more than once in the query instead.
~~~

## PIPELINED_SHUFFLE_UNSUPPORTED

SQLSTATE `0A000`.

~~~text
A pipelined shuffle stage group cannot be scheduled because it uses an unsupported feature: <reason>. Pipelined (incrementally-readable) shuffles run their producer and consumer stages concurrently over a transient, once-through stream, which is incompatible with this feature in this version.
~~~
